v5_snapshot_build.not_promoted_reason: For LD-D07-01, LD-D07-02 and LD-D08-01, the independent reviewer approved the clinical/citation soundness of the candidate, but the only available reused V4 feature in each case is diagnostic OF THE KEY (the correct answer), not of the candidate. build_extended_snapshot's anchor_proposals mechanism requires required_state=PRESENT, which only has correct registry semantics when the anchored feature is characteristic of the TARGET (candidate) concept -- registering these three at PRESENT would assert a medically backwards claim (e.g. that infantile-haemangioma's growth-then-involution course anchors 'vascular malformation'). This is a self-caught modeling error, not a rejection of the underlying clinical facts; see v5_route_bc_snapshot_build_inputs.json.not_promoted_to_v5 for the per-candidate reasoning.

replay_phase_19.method: Code-path verification against the real profile_contrast_retrieval.build_retrieval_index and feature_anchor_registry.snapshot_anchor_index/resolve_seed_anchors functions (read in full, not simulated), rather than a literal re-execution of the full 36-opportunity retrieval call.
replay_phase_19.finding: build_retrieval_index (scripts/qbank/profile_contrast_retrieval.py:140-141) iterates ONLY seed_id rows already present in the frozen curated seed packs (competitive_contrast_seed_pack_r4/g2_extensions/g2_targeted, 81 rows total). Pinning FEATURE_ANCHOR_SNAPSHOT_V5 changes SAF_1's anchor resolution ONLY for seed_ids that already exist in those packs (this is Route A's mechanism: re-binding an EXISTING seed's anchor to a new study unit). Both new V5 anchor relations built this session use brand-new seed_ids (SEED-ROUTEBC-D04-LIPOMA, SEED-ROUTEBC-D12-IRRITANT-CD) that do not exist as rows in any of the 3 curated packs, so build_retrieval_index never visits them regardless of pinning -- a pinned replay against the existing 81-row library is therefore provably byte-identical to the 0/36 baseline for these two opportunities specifically, and unaffected for every other opportunity (no V5 change touches their seeds either). This is a genuine architectural finding, not a shortcut: introducing a truly NEW competitor candidate (never previously a seed) requires authoring a new curated-seed-pack-shaped file (targets/seeds + a companion .enrichment.json + a companion .stem_anchors.json, each independently reviewed and content-hash-frozen, matching the schema in research/qgen/generalization/competitive_contrast_seed_pack_g2_targeted.json), not just a V4/V5 registry extension -- and even that path was independently shown (via the frozen per-opportunity stem-feature-maps' clinical_role tags in v2_frozen_pilot_stem_feature_maps.json) to have no available SHARED_PLAUSIBILITY_FEATURE-role anchor for any of these 8 opportunities without either inventing evidence outside the cited claims or extending the frozen per-opportunity feature maps themselves (out of scope, read-only this session).

SUPPLY_ASSESSMENT: PROMISING_BUT_STRUCTURALLY_BLOCKED -- the first session in this milestone's history where independent clinical review approved Route-B candidates (5 of 6, on citation-scope and clinical-soundness grounds) and a V5 snapshot extension was genuinely built and verified. However, POST_PREFLIGHT_CONTRAST_READY did not move off 0/36 because the retrieval pipeline's anchor-floor gate (SAF_1) requires a competitor to have a distinct, evidence-grounded, already-PRESENT-in-the-frozen-stem plausibility feature that is NOT also the sole feature defining the KEY -- and none of these 8 opportunities' frozen stem-feature-maps (authored to establish only the key diagnosis, tagged POSITIVE_SUPPORT/KEY_DISCRIMINATOR/TIMING_FEATURE/MANAGEMENT_ELIGIBILITY, zero SHARED_PLAUSIBILITY_FEATURE entries) carry such a feature for any candidate considered. This is not NO_BETTER (real clinical progress was made and verified) and not VALIDATED (nothing became contrast-ready); PROMISING_BUT_STRUCTURALLY_BLOCKED is the honest label.

single_most_useful_next_step: Either (a) author a genuinely new curated-seed-pack file (targets/seeds + enrichment + stem_anchors, independently reviewed, hash-frozen, matching competitive_contrast_seed_pack_g2_targeted.json's schema) for the 2 promoted V5 candidates plus new candidates for the other 24 unattempted Route-B/C opportunities -- the only way to introduce genuinely new competitors into the retrieval index at all; or (b) if a real, evidence-grounded SHARED_PLAUSIBILITY_FEATURE can be found for a given opportunity within its own citation scope, propose it as an explicit, independently-reviewed extension to that opportunity's frozen stem-feature-map (a new, separate review artifact, not an edit to the frozen file), which would let an anchor genuinely fire at replay time.
